== 35% ==
{| class="fandom-table"
! colspan="4" |A day lasts approximately 10 hours on Jupiter. If you teleport to Jupiter from the UK on Monday at 9am, and stay there for 8 Jupiter days, what day of the week would it be in the UK when you teleport back to Earth?
|-
|Wednesday
|'''Thursday'''
|Friday
|Saturday
|}
8 Jupiter days last 80 hours. On Earth, 80 hours is 3 days and 8 hours. So you would arrive back in the UK on Thursday at 5pm.

== 30% ==
Which of the words below logically comes next in this sequence?
{| class="fandom-table"
! colspan="3" |'''A'''lcatra'''z''' '''B'''err'''y''' '''C'''o'''x''' ________
|-
|Doughnut
|'''D'''isallo'''w'''
|Dusty
|}
The 1st word starts with the 1st letter of the alphabet and ends with the last letter. The 2nd word starts with the 2nd letter and ends with the 2nd from last. The 4th word in the sequence therefore has to start with the 4th letter ‘D’ and end in the 4th from last ‘W’.
